item.description: Credit extended to Nigeria’s private sector by deposit money banks declined by N1.3 trillion over the past year, reflecting the combined impact of aggressive monetary tightening and rising borrowing costs, even as short-term fluctuations show businesses continue to rely heavily on bank financing.
